topic_text: Topic 2.6: Fixed asset acquisitions and disposals reported gross, not netted, in the cash flow statement
question_html: Garden Ltd. acquired plant and machinery for ₹20 lakhs and sold furniture and fixtures for ₹5 lakhs in the same year. Can the company disclose net cash outflow towards purchase of fixed assets in the cash flow statement per AS 3?
answer_html: No. Per AS 3 para 21, major classes of gross cash receipts and gross cash payments from investing and financing activities must be reported separately, except for the specific items permitted to be reported net under paras 22 and 24 — acquisition and disposal of fixed assets is not among those permitted items. The company cannot net the ₹20 lakh purchase against the ₹5 lakh disposal; both must be shown as separate gross cash flow lines.
mistake_text: Author’s Note: Some examinees assumed netting was acceptable since both items relate to fixed assets, not checking the specific, limited list of items AS 3 actually permits to be reported net.
